name: Custom Command
description: DRAFT of the self-contained Custom Command package (spec version 2): the command and the interval are instance settings; the command text reaches the script as a parameter, never as part of the script text.
author: Bosun

permissions.label: See Custom Command widgets
permissions.description: See the Custom Command widget and the output of its command.

permissions.label: Run commands
permissions.description: Choose the command of a Custom Command widget (it runs as the non-admin account) and run arbitrary commands through the API.

widgets.description: Run a command on the host as its non-admin account and show its output, repeated at the interval you choose

config_schema.label: Command
config_schema.description: Runs as the non-admin shell account of the host each time the widget repeats.

config_schema.label: Repeat every (seconds)
config_schema.description: How often the command runs, from 10 to 3600 seconds. The result is shared by everyone viewing the widget.
